source.manual: Tesla Model 3 Owner's Manual, Child Safety Seats
source.note: Tesla's site refused automated downloads on 2026-10-28, so these rules come from the issue and Tesla's published child seat pages. Check them against the printed manual in the car when it arrives on Nov 5.

rules.text: Never put a rear-facing seat in the front passenger seat while the airbag is on.
rules.text_es: Nunca pongas una silla mirando hacia atrás en el asiento del acompañante con el airbag prendido.

rules.text: ISOFIX anchors are on the two outer rear seats only.
The rear center seat takes a seat installed with the seat belt only.
